title: [Wear] Complications designated Tap for action stops working a short while after app/tile is visited
symptom: On Wear OS, tapping complications configured for 'Tap for action' fails to start the action after a few minutes of inactivity, unless the user visits a tile or app right before. This issue occurs on external watchfaces with complications and was present in versions 3.1, 3.2, and 3.3.
fix: The issue was fixed in a development branch (https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/tree/complication) by MilosKozak, and confirmed working by the reporter after building the wear app from that branch.
evidence_quote: I've built wear app based on https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/tree/complication - You seemed to have fixed this issue. Great job :)
